test_policy: single run after manifest and source commit; raw per-sample outputs mandatory
selection_rule: Choose a threshold from the pre-run v2 dev/cal sweep that passes every maximum margin and gives additional BEM/Kepler tail headroom; 3e-8 was then confirmed on v3 dev/cal before test.
audit_note: Adaptive v2 test is retained as a failed frozen run because three gradient-tail samples exceeded the pre-registered maximum margins. No v2 test sample was used in the v3 threshold sweep or v3 dev/cal confirmation.
